title: BridgePoint Home
description: Residential property intelligence for contractors and property professionals. BridgePoint organizes property records, geospatial context, weather and disaster context, property changes, evidence provenance and explainable prioritization into property-level workflows. Includes a 7-day trial. Signals prioritize investigation and do not prove physical damage, insurance coverage, customer intent or guaranteed outcomes.

title: BridgePoint Commercial
description: Commercial property and business intelligence for teams evaluating buildings, property context, public records, evidence and opportunities. Includes a 7-day trial. BridgePoint is decision-support software and does not itself determine physical damage, insurance coverage or claim outcomes.

title: BridgePoint Investor
description: Property acquisition, distress, redevelopment and market intelligence for real-estate operators and investors. BridgePoint connects fragmented property evidence and context into explainable property-level workflows. Includes a 7-day trial.

title: BridgePoint Company
description: Shared BridgePoint workspace for property-industry teams, with five seats and collaborative opportunity, notes, route and manager workflows. Includes a 7-day trial. Customer access remains controlled by package and geography entitlements.

title: BridgePoint Homeowner
description: One-home property monitoring and intelligence with weather context, timeline, notes and reminders. Includes a 7-day trial. BridgePoint provides decision-support context rather than engineering, legal, insurance or coverage determinations.
